name: sec_omakase
layout: Gradient background from grey (#cfd8df) at the top to white. Top: three white rounded speech bubbles with small round avatar icons (flat illustrated faces, no text) and navy bold text, staggered left-right. Middle: big navy title text 'お任せください！' with small sparkle marks. Bottom: the body text on the left (navy bold, the words '転職サポーター' and '理想の働き方' in orange) and on the right a Japanese woman advisor in a navy suit holding a tablet, cutout.

text_blocks.body_line2: あなたに合った転職サポーターが

style: Japanese landing-page section graphic for smartphone, flat vector UI layout combined with natural photography, crisp heavy Japanese gothic (bold sans-serif) lettering, high contrast, professional advertising quality
text_rule: Render every Japanese string EXACTLY as given in text_blocks, character by character, with correct kanji/hiragana/katakana. Do not add any other text, numbers, logos or watermark. Text must be sharp and legible.
